message.content: Based on the discussion, Jareth expresses a preference for co-op gameplay, particularly for big battle scenes or challenging missions. This suggests that after overcoming significant challenges in single-player mode, Jareth enjoys the camaraderie and cooperative aspects of playing with friends.
